blocks.text: We are overdue for a team lunch, and I would like to get one on the books before the quarter closes and everyone's calendar fills up, so when you have a moment could you find a Friday in the next couple of weeks, hold the back room at the place around the corner, and put a tentative block on people's calendars. Nothing elaborate, just an hour together away from the desks.
Once you have the date locked I will write the group and make sure people actually turn up; the scheduling always seems to land on Lisa Flores, and I do notice it.
